title: Light of the world
gist: Said by Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles, when great lamps burned in the Temple court, and again when he heals the man born blind. In Matthew 5:14 he says the same of his disciples. Light is also the first thing God made (Genesis 1:3) and the image of his law and salvation in the prophets.

passages.note: 'I am the light of the world.'
Said before the healing of the blind man.
'You are the light of the world.'
'The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light.'
